children: on Tuesday it appointed Larry King as CFO and Heather Clayton as Chief Accounting Officer.
King brings more than 35 years of finance, accounting, and operations experience, including SEC reporting, M&A, and operational turnarounds.
He previously served as CFO of Chukchansi Gold Resort & Casino and Riviera Holdings.
Clayton brings nearly 10 years of finance and accounting experience, including senior roles as CFO of ASTOUND Group and the Vegas Golden Knights.
